entry.title: Ironwood · Day 2: The Culvert Grate Where Amara Walked Out Ahead of the Staff
entry.content:
Thursday 5 July 2046, morning

Lost a cat near the Linden Rise culvert, grey with one white ear. Please ring before it gets dark.Handwritten notice taped to a bus shelter, Linden Rise

Isabel travelled out to Linden Rise by train and bus, arriving just after ten. She met Amara Nwosu at the drain lake by the culvert, where Amara had repaired a faulty meter the night before. Isabel waded in to deal with a blight lodged behind the grate, and told Amara to stay at the edge.

Amara moved along the bank instead, drawing the threads out of the pipe after her, and Isabel took them one at a time as they cleared the bars. One thread lashed across the back of Isabel's hand as she gripped the bars, leaving a scald across her knuckles. Amara was also scalded, a thin mark running up her forearm from the wrist. The heart of the blight sits under the ring road and Isabel did not reach it. She said it could not feel them without its nerves and would keep. Amara admitted she had read about this on forums, and Isabel said she had been standing like someone who had done it before.

Isabel then travelled into the north lanes and went to Kell's Lane. A seam she had opened on Tuesday night had closed crooked, running under a fire stair and along the wall to a downpipe, about four metres. Working on it cut a second scald across her hand. She left it unfinished and said she would return the next morning.

Natalie walked the canal path in the evening and met Isabel outside the community rooms by the canal at about eight. Isabel described the culvert and Kell's Lane. Natalie agreed to meet her at Kell's Lane at seven the next morning, after her round, and to take the stair end while Isabel worked the rest. Natalie also said she had told Elspeth Hale that Isabel would bring the jar of ash to Garnet Street, and that Elspeth would hold it for her.

Log

  • Thursday grey weather hangs over the drain lake at Linden Rise, still over its path at the culvert, while Friends of the Tangle meet at the canal rooms and the Back Room plays at the Exchange.
  • Isabel tells Natalie she will finish the north cut alone tomorrow and take the pesto jar of ash to Garnet Street herself, and Natalie agrees that both are Isabel's. (clean, risky, rolled 6 (one die))
    • Isabel buoyed
    • the pesto jar: now with Isabel
    • Isabel now believes: Natalie has handed her the north cut and the jar and means it.
  • Amara steps down into the drain water with her signal box ahead of the rules, and Isabel, who could have caught her sleeve, lets her go, so the threads in the pipe turn toward the girl and the needle climbs to the stop. (failure, risky, rolled 2 (one die))
    • Amara Nwosu lost the rules she'd been given: she went out ahead of them, and the blight came round to her
    • Isabel lost her hold on Amara: the girl went out past the edge Isabel had told her to keep, and Isabel let her
    • Amara Nwosu shaken
    • Isabel now believes: Amara will walk on ahead of any rule she is given.
  • Amara holds the signal box to the grate for a true reading, and the needle lifts to the stop and then drops loose at the bottom, off its pin, so the meter gives no proof. (failure, risky, rolled 2 (one die))
    • Amara Nwosu lost her signal meter's reading: the needle came off its pin, so the box gives no proof
    • the signal meter: now with Amara Nwosu
  • Isabel pins the nerved threads one by one as Amara walks them out along the bank, and the last thread whips back over Amara's wrist and across the back of Isabel's hand, leaving Isabel a scald. (success-with-cost, risky, rolled 4, 5 (two dice keeping the best))
    • Isabel hurt: a scald across her raw knuckles, copper-coloured and weeping
    • Amara Nwosu now believes: Walking slowly along the bank draws the nerved threads out of the pipe to the one with the staff.
    • Isabel now believes: The nerves follow whoever moves closest, which can be a girl walking the bank rather than the one holding the staff.
  • Amara keeps her two earlier cuts hidden, but her feet move as if they have stood at a blight before, and Isabel sees it and asks nothing she can answer. (failure, risky, rolled 1 (one die))
    • Amara Nwosu lost her secret of the two cuts, which Isabel now half knows
    • Amara Nwosu now believes: Isabel now knows that her feet have stood at a blight before.
    • Isabel now believes: Amara has stood at a nerved blight before.
  • Natalie asks Elspeth to wait for Isabel to bring the ash herself, and Elspeth agrees to hold the Hundred and Fourth without taking the jar from Natalie's hand, telling her to say the step is here. (clean, risky, rolled 6 (one die))
    • Natalie buoyed
    • Elspeth Hale now believes: Isabel is the one teaching the Linden Rise girl.
    • Elspeth Hale now believes: Isabel will bring the ash to her herself.
  • Isabel finds the crooked seam under the fire stair, follows its true line four metres along the wall to the downpipe, and takes a scald from the second knuckle to the wrist bone as it pushes back up her staff. (success-with-cost, risky, rolled 4 (one die))
    • Isabel hurt: a scald from the second knuckle to the wrist bone, crossing the first, as wide as a pencil
    • Isabel now believes: The true line runs under the fire stair and along the wall about four metres to the downpipe, and will take an hour to hold open.
    • Mrs Vella now believes: The girl from the second floor is hurt and won't say how.
  • Natalie says she will take the stair end at Kell's Lane tomorrow and do the hard part under the stair herself, and Isabel is left to watch, having given up finishing the cut alone. (failure, risky, rolled 1 (one die))
    • Isabel lost her plan to finish the north cut alone, given up for the stair end and the root under it
    • Isabel now believes: Natalie will take the stair end and leave the rest of the cut for Isabel to watch.
    • Natalie now believes: Isabel can't take the bit under the stair alone with her hand as it is.

entry.title: Ironwood · Day 1: The Answer Given in Daylight on the Canal Bank
entry.content:
Wednesday 4 July 2046, morning

DO NOT USE THE TOWPATH AFTER HEAVY RAIN.Council notice, cable-tied to the railing of the old canal bridge

The night's rain had pushed the drain lake at Linden Rise over its path and jammed the reeds against the culvert grate under the ring road. Amara Nwosu stood there with her half-built meter, a box for measuring the signal, the pressure blight put behind her teeth. The reeds had gone black at the root, and the needle jumped whenever she turned toward the grate. Isabel, whom she had asked for help, had not answered.

Across town, Isabel woke in Natalie's flat to an empty bed and the coat gone from the hook. Natalie had slipped out first, so that no one would ask where she was going. Isabel caught her on the bank by the old canal bridge. Natalie halted at her voice, because she had been seen.

Isabel made herself look at Natalie's face and asked whether last night still stood, in daylight.

"It stands," Natalie said.

Then why the bridge, Iz thought. Next time she would be up first.

Amara wrote again, asking to be shown how to cut a nerved blight down to its root. She left out the two cuts she had already made alone, so that Isabel would not refuse her. Isabel agreed to show her when they could meet. Amara turned the phone face down on the wet stone.

Log

  • The night's rain pushed the drain lake at Linden Rise over its path and jammed the reeds against the culvert grate under the ring road, while Amara's half-built signal meter kept jumping and Isabel still hadn't answered. (clean, risky, rolled 6 (one die))
    • Amara Nwosu buoyed
  • Amara sent Isabel a second message asking to be shown how to cut nerved blight, without mentioning the two cuts she has already made alone; Isabel agreed to show her when they can meet. (success-with-cost, risky, rolled 4 (one die))
    • Amara Nwosu ashamed
    • Isabel now believes: That Amara has never cut a nerved blight and is asking how for the first time.
  • Isabel made herself look at Natalie's face and ask whether last night still stands in daylight; Natalie said yes, it still stands, and Isabel could not read anything past the answer. (success-with-cost, risky, rolled 5 (one die))
    • Isabel shaken
  • Natalie slipped out of the flat before Isabel woke and got as far as the canal bridge, where Isabel, who had come looking for her, caught her on the bank above the black water. (failure, risky, rolled 1 (one die))
    • Natalie ashamed
    • Isabel now believes: That Natalie was slipping out to leave her, not going down to the water.
